parts.text:
The doorbell camera pings at 3:12 every night. I work overnight at the hospital, so I watch the recordings at home. Every one shows the same silhouette, standing perfectly still on my porch with its back to the door.

I told myself it was a prank, until I noticed the date on the recordings. It said tomorrow.

Tonight I sat on the porch steps and waited patiently. At 3:12 it pinged, and the new recording showed me from behind. Then my front door opened behind me, and something stepped out of the abandoned house. I felt cold air on my neck as the doorbell camera pinged again.
parts.hook: The doorbell camera pings at 3:12 every night.
